about_the_game:
Terror Call – A Horror Game Made With Heart for Tamil Gamers with English Support

Terror Call is a chilling horror game crafted especially for Tamil gamers — but anyone can dive into it. With full Tamil voice dialogues, English subtitles, and paper hints written in Tamil (with English translations), this game blends fear with cultural flavor.

You’ll explore eerie rooms, solve haunting puzzles, and try to escape the unknown — all while jump scares and disturbing sounds keep you on edge.

Key Features:

  • 🎙️ Authentic Tamil Experience – Voice-acted entirely in Tamil, with English subtitles to guide non-Tamil players

  • 📜 Story Through Hints – Read cryptic notes written in Tamil, subtly translated for global players

  • 👣 Fear That Follows – Dynamic jumpscares, unsettling whispers, and footsteps in the dark

  • 🧠 Smart Puzzles – Every room holds a secret. Only the bold and clever escape

  • 🔓 Non-linear Escapes – Doors, keys, and locks with more than one way out — if you dare to look

  • 👁️ Immersive First-Person Horror – You’re not just playing. You’re inside

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (Intel Only)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best in 720p with low graphics on minimum supported macOS devices
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina) or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (Universal Binary or Intel Only)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU / Intel Iris Plus / Radeon Pro 555X or better
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard onboard audio
  • Additional Notes: For best experience, play with graphics set to Medium or High at 1080p
